name: ルナ
description: いろんなジャンルのイラストを投稿するアカウントです😪 20↑。無言フォロー&フォローバック失礼します。Misskey→https://misskey.io/@luna_runa

works.body:
Hello! I'm Sensai Tsuina. I have been following Runa because of my love for Gintama and Aikatsu! 

My favourite art is Akari-chan Illustration: x.com/runa_korira/status/1774451951943713173

I would love to ask if you could draw my character facing the camera sat in front of a piano. 
I would like to ask if you could draw the mouth in different layers to be able to sing the words '天使のコンサート'.
This is because I would like to use this illustration as part of my original song and would like to have it animated. Would you be able to supply layers as much as possible to animate it?
If not, that is okay, please accept this request if you could separate the mouth to dictate '天使のコンサート'.
Please supply the illustration as 16:9 and PSD file as it will be for a song in youtube. 

Separated Layers:
- Eyes (Looking and winking)
- Mouth saying '天使のコンサート' (Open (て), (の) and smiling)
- Hair
- Wings
- Hair Accessories
- Musical Note Halo
- Necklace

Thank you for your consideration.
